title: Gravity Well
description: An FM bass voice that slides from subterranean reese growl up into shrieking full-spectrum highs as its pitch envelope accelerates and the FM index swells. Wet delay tails and a deep room let each note smear into the next like signals bending around a gravity well.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 [c1 eb1] g0 c1 [g0 bb0] f1 <eb1 c2>>/2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(19).range(2, 13)).fmh("<1 1.5 0.5 2 1>/4")
    .penv("<0 7 24 -7 36 -12>/8").pattack(0.004).pdecay(sine.slow(11).range(0.06, 0.4))
    .accelerate(saw.slow(23).range(-0.4, 0.6))
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(180, 5200)).resonance(15).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(13).range(1, 6)).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.18)
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(17).range(0.1, 1.2))
    .attack(0.005).decay(0.22).sustain(0.55).release(0.08)
    .shape(sine.slow(29).range(0.15, 0.5))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .off(3/16, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).pan(0.75).fm(8))
    .delay("0.6:0.375:0.72").room(sine.slow(24).range(0.4, 0.9))
    .gain(0.85)
)
